expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover the ABI IR JSON, digest/public input, and DSSE/receipt statements; then implement one accept and one reject verifier fixture before expanding to FRI/PCS.
expected_groups.focus: sumcheck toy family with ABI/digest/receipt coverage
expected_groups.why_p0: This is the smallest visible streamfold lane with ABI IR, public commitment, and receipt/attestation roles all present in the canonical index.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover FRI ABI variants and receipt statement; bind one mined/latest variant to a deterministic verifier before claiming protocol correctness.
expected_groups.focus: FRI opening toy lane and associated receipt
expected_groups.why_p0: FRI-open artifacts are protocol-adjacent and include a mined/latest variant that risks being overread without the verifier and public inputs.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover raw/mined lookup-permutation variants and decide which one is canonical before any proof-carrying claim names lookup support.
expected_groups.why_p0: Multiple lookup variants imply canonicalization risk: wrong variant selection could invalidate later verifier commitments.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover ABI IR and bind it to verifier/public-input artifacts or explicitly mark it as a paper-only/reference lane.
expected_groups.why_p0: Halo2 naming creates strong proof-system expectations; leaving it unmapped invites overclaiming.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover checkpoint, receipt metadata, verification reports, and split-view variants; define accept/reject semantics before publication.
expected_groups.focus: policy transition checkpoint and receipt variants
expected_groups.why_p0: Transition checkpoint material is governance/security critical and contains receipt plus mutated/split-view signals.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover accept and reject DSSE statements and make the verifier identify which policy proof predicates were checked.
expected_groups.why_p0: Accept/reject naming is close to executable proof semantics and must not be left as opaque evidence blobs.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover transition-ok statements and verify reports; bind monitor identity and public status fields before claiming monitoring correctness.
expected_groups.why_p0: Monitor attestation is a high-risk operational trust boundary; false positives could make bad evidence look live/valid.

expected_groups.closure_gate: Recover receipt DSSE files and replay transcript; decide whether this is a dependency/surface-policy lane or outside the proofcore core.
expected_groups.focus: surface gate and ABOM verdict receipt lane
expected_groups.why_p0: PACT receipts are numerous and can distract from SNARK-adjacent proofcore unless one narrow receipt lane is chosen or deferred explicitly.

non_claims: not proof-system soundness for missing streamfold or zkrtp payloads
